_comment: Single source of truth for every UI string. Add a language by adding its column to every entry and to languages.json. Both the settings panel (fetch) and the native Windows layer (config read at startup) load this file.

wallpaper.note.after.zh: ，单文件 HTML 建议把 CSS/JS 内联，文件夹需要根目录下有 index.html。
wallpaper.note.after.en: . Inline CSS/JS for single-file imports; folders need an index.html at their root.

params.fpsHint.zh: 不限 = 跟随显示器刷新率；也可以自己填 1–240
params.fpsHint.en: Unlimited = follow the display; or type any value from 1 to 240

params.customTitle.zh: 自定义帧率上限（1–240），回车或失焦生效
params.customTitle.en: Custom frame cap (1–240), applied on Enter or blur

params.densityHint.zh: 粒子 / 光斑 / 字符列的数量

params.note.zh: 三个参数对所有壁纸生效，改动立即应用并写入 config.json。
params.note.en: All three apply to every wallpaper, take effect immediately and are saved to config.json.

settings.pauseFullscreenHint.zh: 检测到全屏游戏 / 视频时停止渲染
settings.pauseFullscreenHint.en: Stop rendering while a game or video is fullscreen

settings.pauseLockHint.zh: 息屏 / 锁屏后释放 GPU
settings.pauseLockHint.en: Release the GPU when the screen is off or locked

settings.pauseCovered.en: Pause when a window is maximized

settings.pauseCoveredHint.zh: 有最大化窗口盖住桌面时停止渲染
settings.pauseCoveredHint.en: Stop rendering while a maximized window covers the desktop

settings.pausePanel.en: Pause while this panel is open

settings.pausePanelHint.en: Off by default; the wallpaper only drops to 30 fps

settings.pointer.en: Stream the cursor to the wallpaper

settings.pointerHint.zh: 把光标位置推给壁纸页面，视差 / 追光 / 交互要用它
settings.pointerHint.en: Parallax, cursor glow and other effects rely on it

settings.devtoolsHint.en: Applies the next time a view is created

about.fpsHint.zh: 壁纸页面每 2 秒上报一次；60 表示满帧，掉到 50 以下说明真的在丢帧
about.fpsHint.en: Reported every 2 seconds; 60 is a full frame, below 50 means real drops

about.note.zh: 壁纸页面与设置面板共用一套桥接接口：bridge.send(json) / bridge.onMessage(cb)。
about.note.en: Both views share one bridge API: bridge.send(json) / bridge.onMessage(cb).

pause.disabled.zh: 已禁用，桌面背景已恢复

toast.disabled.zh: 壁纸已禁用，桌面背景已恢复

toast.nameTaken.zh: 同名壁纸已存在，请先移除或改名
toast.nameTaken.en: A wallpaper with that name already exists — remove or rename it first

toast.noIndex.zh: 这个文件夹里没有 index.html，请选网页构建产物的根目录
toast.noIndex.en: That folder has no index.html — pick the root of a web build

toast.copyTemplateFailed.en: Could not copy the player template:

toast.writePageFailed.en: Could not write the player page:

toast.mkdirFailed.en: Could not create the wallpaper folder:

native.pickFileTitle.zh: 选择壁纸文件（网页或视频）
native.pickFileTitle.en: Choose a wallpaper file (web page or video)

native.pickFolderTitle.zh: 选择壁纸文件夹（根目录需包含 index.html）
native.pickFolderTitle.en: Choose a wallpaper folder (must contain index.html at its root)

native.pickHtmlTitle.zh: 选择壁纸 HTML 文件（建议自包含：CSS/JS 内联）
native.pickHtmlTitle.en: Choose an HTML wallpaper (inline its CSS/JS if possible)

native.noMainWindow.en: Could not create the main window

native.needRuntime.zh: 请安装 Microsoft Edge WebView2 运行时后重试
native.needRuntime.en: Please install the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime and try again
